Thanks, Olga — quick legal confirmation. I reviewed the indemnity language in the PDF and propose the following concrete compromise to give Atlas comfort while limiting Redwood exposure: replace current cap language with a mutual cap equal to the greater of $5M or 12 months of fees paid under the Order Form, excluding gross negligence / willful misconduct carve-outs. For integration-related claims we accept a focused carve-out but limit aggregate exposure to $1M.

If Atlas can accept that, we are comfortable moving to signature. I've pasted a one-line replacement for the MSA (for your counsel/Elaine):

"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, the aggregate liability of each party for claims arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) five million dollars (USD 5,000,000) or (ii) the total fees paid to Redwood under the applicable Order Form in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. Notwithstanding the foregoing, liability for claims arising from gross negligence or willful misconduct and the integration carve-out shall be limited to $1,000,000 for each party."

Elaine — happy to sync if you'd like to redline wording further; otherwise we can insert this as a tracked change and proceed.
